WITH sl AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (receipt_id, line_no) * FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2024-10-28' AND '2026-01-25'
  ORDER BY receipt_id, line_no, etl_loaded_at DESC
),
nl AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date AS bd, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS v FROM sl f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id<900 AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id<900 AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND r.return_date BETWEEN '2024-10-28' AND '2026-01-25'
),
mine AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, n.store_id, round(sum(v),2) mine FROM nl n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.bd WHERE d.fiscal_quarter=3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26') GROUP BY 1,2),
rpt AS (SELECT d.fiscal_year, r.store_id, round(sum(r.net_sales),2) rpt FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date WHERE d.fiscal_quarter=3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26') AND r.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT coalesce(m.fiscal_year,r.fiscal_year) fy, coalesce(m.store_id,r.store_id) st, m.mine, r.rpt, round(coalesce(m.mine,0)-coalesce(r.rpt,0),2) diff
FROM mine m FULL JOIN rpt r ON r.fiscal_year=m.fiscal_year AND r.store_id=m.store_id
WHERE abs(coalesce(m.mine,0)-coalesce(r.rpt,0))>0.05 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= d.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= d.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= d.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= d.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_week, fiscal_week_start_date, fiscal_week_end_date
                FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26') AND fiscal_week BETWEEN 27 AND 39) d
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900 AND st.store_id <> 999
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
    JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= DATE '2025-10-27' - 364)
)

WITH store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= d.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= d.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= d.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= d.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_week, fiscal_week_start_date, fiscal_week_end_date
                FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26') AND fiscal_week BETWEEN 27 AND 39) d
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
    JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= DATE '2025-10-27' - 364)
),
sales_dedup AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (receipt_id, line_no) *
    FROM fact_sales_line
    WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2026-01-25'
    ORDER BY receipt_id, line_no, etl_loaded_at DESC
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM sales_dedup f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2026-01-25'
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT cs.region, d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25') AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 27 AND 39
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT ty.region, ROUND(ty.net_sales,2) AS this_year_net_sales, ROUND(ly.net_sales,2) AS last_year_net_sales,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM lfl_sales ty JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.region = ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
ORDER BY ty.region

SELECT r.store_id, s.region, round(sum(CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN r.net_sales END)) ty, round(sum(CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' THEN r.net_sales END)) ly,
 round(100*(sum(CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN r.net_sales END)/sum(CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' THEN r.net_sales END)-1),1) g,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN r.business_date END) dty, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' THEN r.business_date END) dly
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id=r.store_id AND s.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_quarter=3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26') AND r.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY g
